findings.message: Calling the tāṇḍava 'whirling' ('घूमता' in the Hindi) goes beyond the cited excerpt. mw-tandava.md (MW p. 441,3) gives only 'dancing (esp. with violent gesticulation), frantic dance (of Śiva and his votaries)', and no other evidence file mentions whirling. It is a small descriptive detail, but no source in the evidence supports it.
findings.suggested_fix: EN: 'Tāṇḍava is Śiva's wild, frantic dance'; HI: '*ताण्डव* शिव का उन्मत्त, प्रचण्ड नृत्य है'.
